body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0178 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "WMI process call via powershell - Behavior: WMI process call via powershell. Anchor after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0178"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1047"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase
    ($e.target.process.command_line = /Invoke-WmiMethod/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /Get-WmiObject/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /Invoke-CimMethod/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /wmic / nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
